text: Python CLI, single file cron_parser.py, stdlib only
Parse standard 5-field cron expressions; reject wrong field count
validate <expr> explains each field for a valid expression
validate <expr> reports the error for an invalid expression (non-zero exit, message)
next <expr> prints next run times from now (default count)
next <expr> -n N prints exactly N run times, correct and strictly after now
Handle invalid dates like February 30 (no crash, never produce impossible dates; impossible schedule reported)
Standard day-of-month / day-of-week OR semantics when both restricted
Errors produce clean messages, not tracebacks
